name: ROSE – rapid on-site evaluation (adequacy & triage)
use: Adequacy assessment and triage for ancillary tests.

adequacy.title: Adequacy
items: Diff-Quik/rapid Pap; assess cellularity; allocate passes for cell block, flow, culture, molecular.

diagnoses.name: Adequate – lesional cells present
diagnoses.final: ROSE: adequate; lesional cells present. Preliminary: [impression].

diagnoses.name: Inadequate – further passes
diagnoses.final: ROSE: not adequate; further passes requested.
diagnoses.comment: Communicate to operator immediately; consider different target area, needle size or technique.

diagnoses.name: Lymphoid – triage for flow cytometry
diagnoses.final: ROSE: lymphoid population; additional pass in RPMI for flow cytometry.
diagnoses.comment: Place pass in RPMI/transport medium; also make cell block for IHC.

diagnoses.name: Granulomas/necrosis – triage for culture
diagnoses.final: ROSE: granulomas/necrosis; pass for AFB culture/CBNAAT.
diagnoses.comment: Send dedicated pass in saline for AFB culture/CBNAAT and fungal culture.

diagnoses.name: Carcinoma – triage for cell block/molecular
diagnoses.final: ROSE: malignant cells; extra passes for cell block and biomarker testing.
diagnoses.comment: Dedicated passes for cell block to allow IHC and predictive biomarkers (e.g. EGFR, ALK, PD-L1 in lung).

extra.title: Status
items: Consensus/descriptive – no official international reporting system.

references: Cibas ES, Ducatman BS. Cytology: Diagnostic Principles and Clinical Correlates. 5th ed. Elsevier, 2020.
WHO Reporting System for Lung Cytopathology, IAC-IARC 1st ed (ROSE and triage sections).
Orell SR, Sterrett GF. Orell and Sterrett's Fine Needle Aspiration Cytology. 5th ed. Churchill Livingstone, 2012.
